name: House Cleaning
metaTitle: House Cleaning Services in the GTA | Neat Squad
metaDescription: Reliable weekly, biweekly, and monthly house cleaning across the Greater Toronto Area. Book Neat Squad today and get a spotless home you can count on.
heroHeadline: House Cleaning You Can Set Your Watch By
heroSubheadline: Neat Squad delivers dependable recurring house cleaning to homes across the Greater Toronto Area.
overview:
Keeping a home consistently clean takes time most people simply don't have. Neat Squad's house cleaning service is built around your schedule, offering weekly, biweekly, or monthly visits that keep every room fresh, tidy, and sanitized without you having to lift a finger. Our team follows a consistent routine each visit, so your home gets the same careful attention every single time.

Whether you're a busy family juggling work and kids, a professional who'd rather spend evenings relaxing than scrubbing floors, or simply someone who values a clean, calm living space, our recurring house cleaning plans are designed to fit real life across the GTA. You choose the frequency and the rooms that matter most, and we handle the rest with care and attention to detail.

benefits.title: Flexible Scheduling
benefits.description: Choose weekly, biweekly, or monthly visits that fit around your work and family routine.

benefits.title: Consistent Results
benefits.description: The same cleaning checklist is followed every visit so your home looks and feels the same fresh way each time.

benefits.title: More Free Time
benefits.description: Get your evenings and weekends back instead of spending them on chores.

benefits.title: Healthier Home Environment
benefits.description: Regular dusting, vacuuming, and disinfecting help cut down on allergens and household germs.

benefits.title: Customizable Focus Areas
benefits.description: Ask us to prioritize specific rooms or tasks, like kitchens or bathrooms, on any given visit.

whatsIncluded: Dusting of all reachable surfaces, shelves, and furniture
Vacuuming carpets and rugs throughout the home
Mopping hard floors in kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas
Cleaning and disinfecting kitchen countertops and sinks
Sanitizing bathroom fixtures, mirrors, and tile
Emptying trash and replacing liners
Making beds and tidying visible clutter
Wiping down light switches, door handles, and other high-touch points
Cleaning interior glass on doors and low windows

process.title: Request a Free Quote
process.description: Tell us about your home's size and how often you'd like it cleaned, and we'll put together a personalized quote.

process.title: Confirm & Schedule
process.description: Pick a day and time that works for you, and we'll lock in a recurring spot on our calendar.

process.title: We Clean
process.description: Our team arrives on schedule and works through your home following a consistent, detailed checklist.

process.title: Walkthrough & Feedback
process.description: We welcome a quick look-through and any feedback so future visits can be fine-tuned to your preferences.

pricingNote: The cost of house cleaning depends on factors like the size of your home, the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, how often you'd like us to come, and the current condition of the space. Homes that are cleaned regularly typically cost less per visit than a one-time deep clean. Request a free, no-obligation quote and we'll give you a clear price based on your specific home.

faqs.question: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
faqs.answer: No, many of our GTA clients provide a key, garage code, or lockbox and are comfortable with us cleaning while they're at work or out. If you'd prefer to be home, that's completely fine too, whatever makes you comfortable.

faqs.question: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies and equipment?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team typically brings the supplies and equipment needed for a standard cleaning. If you have specific products you'd like us to use, such as for allergies or sensitivities, just let us know in advance.

faqs.question: What's the difference between this and a deep clean?
faqs.answer: Standard house cleaning is a maintenance-level clean focused on the everyday areas of your home on a recurring basis. A deep clean goes further into detail work like baseboards, inside appliances, and buildup that accumulates over time, and is a good starting point if it's been a while since your last thorough clean.

faqs.question: Can I change or skip a scheduled visit?
faqs.answer: We understand plans change, so just reach out with as much notice as you can and we'll do our best to reschedule or adjust your visit.

faqs.question: What areas of the GTA do you service?
faqs.answer: We serve homes across the Greater Toronto Area. If you're unsure whether your neighbourhood is covered, reach out and we'll confirm availability for your address.

idealFor: Busy professionals who want a spotless home without spending their free time cleaning
Families juggling work, school, and activities who need consistent help around the house
Homeowners who want to maintain a clean space between occasional deep cleans
Anyone who values coming home to a tidy, fresh environment every week

overview:
Ontario winters and everyday weather take a toll on the outside of your home, leaving driveways, walkways, and siding covered in grime, salt residue, mildew, and built-up dirt. Neat Squad's exterior cleaning service uses pressure washing to lift away that buildup and bring surfaces back to looking fresh, without damaging the material underneath.

We clean driveways, walkways, patios, decks, and siding for homeowners across the Greater Toronto Area who want to boost their curb appeal, prep for a season of outdoor living, or simply keep their property looking well maintained. It's an easy way to make a big visual difference to the outside of your home.

benefits.title: Removes Built-Up Grime

benefits.title: Helps Protect Surfaces

benefits.title: Great Before Big Events

pricingNote: Pricing for driveway and exterior cleaning depends on the total surface area, the type of material, how many surfaces you'd like cleaned, and how heavy the buildup is. A small walkway and a large multi-surface property will naturally differ in cost. Request a free, no-obligation quote and we'll assess your specific property.

faqs.question: Is pressure washing safe for all surfaces?
faqs.answer: Different materials require different pressure levels and techniques, which is why we adjust our approach based on what we're cleaning, such as concrete versus wood decking or siding. If a surface seems too delicate or worn for pressure washing, we'll let you know honestly before starting.

faqs.question: Will pressure washing remove oil stains from my driveway?
faqs.answer: We can often improve the appearance of oil or rust stains, but some older or deeply set stains may not come out completely. We'll always be upfront about what results you can realistically expect before we begin.

faqs.question: What time of year is best for exterior cleaning?
faqs.answer: Many homeowners in the GTA schedule cleaning in spring to remove winter salt and grime, or in fall to prep for the colder months, but we can generally work whenever weather conditions allow. We avoid scheduling during freezing temperatures or heavy rain.

faqs.question: Do I need to be home during the service?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, as long as we have access to the areas being cleaned and, if needed, an outdoor water source. We can coordinate access details with you ahead of time.

faqs.question: Will this damage my plants or landscaping?
faqs.answer: We take care to work around landscaping and will avoid directing high-pressure water at delicate plants. If you have specific areas you're concerned about, just point them out before we start.

idealFor: Homeowners preparing their property for spring or fall after months of buildup
Sellers wanting to boost curb appeal before listing photos or showings
Anyone hosting an outdoor gathering who wants a fresh-looking patio or deck
Property owners looking to maintain concrete, siding, and wood surfaces over time

Our move-in and move-out cleaning is built specifically for transitions, helping renters and homeowners across the Greater Toronto Area hand over or move into a space that's genuinely clean from corner to corner. Whether you're closing out a lease, prepping a home for new owners, or want your new place clean before you unpack, this service is designed to handle the intensive work in one visit.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a deep clean and a regular house cleaning?
faqs.answer: A deep clean covers detail-level areas like baseboards, inside appliances, and grout that aren't part of a standard recurring visit. It typically takes longer and is a great one-time reset before starting a regular cleaning schedule.

faqs.question: Should the home be empty for a move-in/move-out clean?
faqs.answer: An empty home lets us access cabinets, closets, and floors fully, which usually leads to a more thorough result. We can still work in a partially furnished space, just let us know the condition when requesting a quote.

faqs.question: Can this help meet my landlord's move-out cleaning requirements?
faqs.answer: Our move-out cleaning is designed to leave a rental looking clean and well cared for, but we can't guarantee it will satisfy every specific lease clause, since requirements vary. If you have a checklist from your landlord, share it with us so we can address those points directly.

faqs.question: How long does a deep clean typically take?
faqs.answer: Time depends on the size of the home and its current condition, so a small condo and a large house will differ quite a bit. We'll give you a time estimate along with your quote.

faqs.question: Can I book a deep clean as a one-time service?
faqs.answer: Yes, this service is commonly booked as a standalone one-time clean, whether for a move, a seasonal reset, or before hosting guests. There's no obligation to sign up for recurring service afterward.

idealFor: Renters who need a thorough clean before returning keys at the end of a lease

Households resetting a space that hasn't had a deep clean in a long time

faqs.question: How long does it take for carpets to dry after cleaning?
faqs.answer: Drying time varies depending on the method used, humidity, and airflow in the room, but steam-cleaned carpets often take several hours to dry fully. We'll give you an estimate and some tips to help speed up drying after your visit.

faqs.question: Can you remove all stains from carpets or upholstery?
faqs.answer: We can significantly improve the appearance of most stains, but some older or set-in stains may not come out completely depending on the fabric and stain type. We'll be honest with you about what to expect before we start.

faqs.question: Is the cleaning process safe for pets and children?
faqs.answer: We aim to use cleaning methods and products intended for household use, and we're happy to discuss any specific sensitivities or concerns you have beforehand. If you'd like extra time before pets or kids are back on the carpet, we can advise based on drying time.

faqs.question: Do you clean area rugs as well as wall-to-wall carpet?
faqs.answer: Yes, we clean both area rugs and wall-to-wall carpeting, along with upholstered furniture and mattresses. Just let us know what you'd like cleaned when requesting your quote.

faqs.question: How often should carpets and upholstery be professionally cleaned?
faqs.answer: This depends on foot traffic, pets, allergies, and how the space is used, so there's no single answer that fits every home. Many homeowners in the GTA find that an annual or semi-annual cleaning helps keep carpets and furniture looking their best.

idealFor: Homeowners with high-traffic carpeted areas that need a deeper refresh
